name: Stone of Rebirth
desc: A tool decorated with butterflies, symbolizing the cycle of death and rebirth. The stone in the center possesses fabulous power and is said to be able to cure all manner of injuries and illnesses.

eff.name: Sanctuary's Protection
eff.desc1: Grants [Lv. x 1] stack(s) of Resist KO to the target.
eff.desc2: Restores target's HP with [Lv. x 100] power. Consumes half of your environmental mana and reduces cooldowns in proportion to the amount consumed.

eff.name: Last Stand
eff.desc1: Boosts target's ATK, DEF, and SPD by [Lv. x 5]% if their HP is at 50% or lower.
eff.desc2: Boosts target's ATK, DEF, and SPD by [Lv. x 5]% if their HP is at 50% or higher.

eff.name: Cycle of Life
eff.desc1: Boosts target's maximum HP by [Lv. x 10]%.
eff.desc2: If HP is restored beyond the maximum amount, boosts maximum HP by [Lv. x 5]% of that restoration.
